info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package analytics implements the canonical /v1/analytics/* API, metric catalog, automatic query planner, IAM tenant isolation, Hanzo KV acceleration layer, and shared coalesced Server-Sent Events (SSE) real-time hub for Hanzo Unified Global Analytics.

get.summary: Stream coalesced real-time analytics updates as Server-Sent Events
get.description: Holds one text/event-stream open per viewer while coalescing all viewers on the same authorized scope (`global` for SuperAdmin, `org:<slug>` for tenant callers) onto ONE shared backend refresh loop. Publishes monotonic `version` integers: `event: snapshot` on connect, `event: delta` when the version advances, and `: ping` every 25s. Pass `?since_version=<n>` on reconnect to receive `: up-to-date` instead of resending an unchanged snapshot.

activeParts.description: ActiveParts is the total number of active MergeTree parts across the analytics database.

reachable.description: Reachable is true when Datastore answered a live probe.

asOf.description: AsOf is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the returned snapshot was computed.

lagMs.description: LagMs is the age of the snapshot in milliseconds relative to response time.

source.description: Source identifies the primary upstream pipeline or storage layer.

stale.description: Stale is true when served from a last-known Hanzo KV snapshot during a Datastore outage.

freshness.description: Freshness reports snapshot timestamp, lag, staleness, source, and accuracy.

maxLagMs.description: MaxLagMs is the highest watermark lag across all pipelines in milliseconds.

pipelines.description: Pipelines lists per-pipeline watermarks read from analytics.watermarks.

stalePipelines.description: StalePipelines counts pipelines whose status is "lagging" or "stalled".

totalDriftCents.description: TotalDriftCents is the sum of absolute financial reconciliation drift across pipelines in USD cents.

data.description: Data holds the per-pipeline freshness watermarks and reconciliation summary.

msg.description: Msg carries an error message when Status is "error", empty otherwise.

status.description: Status is "ok" on success or "error" on failure.

checkedAt.description: CheckedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when health was probed.

datastore.description: Datastore reports Datastore reachability, active parts, and merge pressure.

kv.description: KV reports Hanzo KV configuration and reachability.

semaphore.description: Semaphore reports bounded Datastore query concurrency utilization.

status.description: Status is the overall analytics plane verdict ("healthy" or "degraded").

streams.description: Streams reports live coalesced SSE subscriber and scope hub counts.

data.description: Data holds the analytics subsystem health breakdown.

msg.description: Msg carries an error message when Status is "error", empty otherwise.

status.description: Status is "ok" on success or "error" on failure.

configured.description: Configured is true when a KV backend URL or store is wired.

error.description: Error records the last ping error when Configured is true and Reachable is false.

reachable.description: Reachable is true when the KV store responded to a health ping.

accuracy.description: Accuracy indicates whether the metric is exact, approximate (sketch/HLL/t-digest), or estimated.

description.description: Description explains what the metric measures and its exact semantic meaning.

dimensions.description: Dimensions lists the group_by dimension keys permitted for this metric.

domain.description: Domain groups metrics by business/operational plane across the 14 Hanzo domains.

freshnessTargetSec.description: FreshnessTargetSec is the target end-to-end ingestion lag SLA in seconds.

id.description: ID is the canonical dotted metric identifier (e.g. "commerce.revenue", "ai.tokens").

source.description: Source names the upstream data pipeline that populates this metric.

tables.description: Tables lists the pre-aggregated analytics.* / hanzo.* tables backing this metric.

unit.description: Unit is the measurement unit (usd_cents, count, tokens, bytes, ratio, bps, ms, seats).

metrics.description: Metrics lists every registered metric definition matching the optional domain filter.

total.description: Total is the count of metrics returned.

data.description: Data holds the registered metric catalog definitions.

msg.description: Msg carries an error message when Status is "error", empty otherwise.

status.description: Status is "ok" on success or "error" on failure.

activeUsers.description: ActiveUsers is distinct active users in this scope over the selected window.

aiBilledCents.description: AIBilledCents is customer-billed AI charges over the selected window in USD cents.

aiCostCents.description: AICostCents is upstream provider AI cost over the selected window in USD cents.

aiMarginCents.description: AIMarginCents is gross AI margin (billed minus cost) in USD cents.

aiRequests.description: AIRequests is total AI inference requests served over the selected window.

aiTokens.description: AITokens is total AI tokens processed over the selected window.

arrCents.description: ARRCents is current run-rate Annual Recurring Revenue (MRR * 12) in USD cents.

cashHeldCents.description: CashHeldCents is current unspent customer prepaid cash balance in USD cents.

creditOutstandingCents.description: CreditOutstandingCents is current unspent granted credit balance in USD cents.

mrrCents.description: MRRCents is current run-rate Monthly Recurring Revenue in USD cents.

o11yErrors.description: O11yErrors is total observed 5xx/error spans over the selected window.

o11yP95Ms.description: O11yP95Ms is the 95th-percentile service latency in milliseconds.

o11yRequests.description: O11yRequests is total observed HTTP/RPC requests over the selected window.

orgs.description: Orgs is total registered organizations visible in this scope.

productEvents.description: ProductEvents is total product telemetry events ingested over the selected window.

productVisitors.description: ProductVisitors is distinct product visitors observed over the selected window.

revenueCents.description: RevenueCents is recognized revenue over the selected window in USD cents.

spendCents.description: SpendCents is total metered spend over the selected window in USD cents.

users.description: Users is total real user accounts visible in this scope.

lagMs.description: LagMs is the end-to-end watermark lag in milliseconds.

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the canonical ingestion pipeline name (e.g. "commerce", "ai_ledger", "iam", "o11y").

reconciliationDriftCents.description: ReconciliationDriftCents is the financial reconciliation drift versus authoritative commerce books in USD cents.

rowsProcessed.description: RowsProcessed is the cumulative row count processed by this pipeline.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is when this watermark row was last recorded (RFC3339 UTC).

watermarkAt.description: WatermarkAt is the latest committed event timestamp processed by this pipeline (RFC3339 UTC).

granularity.description: Granularity is the aggregation bucket selected ("minute", "hour", "day", or "snapshot").

limit.description: Limit is the enforced row limit ceiling (default 100, max 500).

scope.description: Scope is the enforced IAM isolation scope ("global" or "org:<slug>").

table.description: Table is the coarsest sufficient pre-aggregated analytics.* table queried.

window.description: Window is the normalized lookback duration (e.g. "24h", "7d", "30d", "90d").

freshness.description: Freshness reports snapshot timestamp, lag, stale degradation state, source, and accuracy.

plan.description: Plan describes the aggregate table, window, granularity, scope, and limit chosen by the planner.

rows.description: Rows lists the grouped analytical rows ordered by time or leading metric descending.

totals.description: Totals maps each requested canonical metric ID to its overall aggregate across the window.

granularity.description: Granularity selects "auto", "minute", "hour", or "day". Defaults to "auto" (coarsest sufficient table).

group_by.description: GroupBy lists up to 2 allowed dimension keys for this metric family (e.g. ["model", "day"]).

limit.description: Limit caps returned grouped rows (default 100, max 500).

metrics.description: Metrics lists one or more registered canonical metric IDs (e.g. ["ai.requests", "ai.tokens"]).

org.description: Org optionally narrows a SuperAdmin query to one tenant org. Forbidden for non-super callers trying to read another org.

window.description: Window is the lookback window (e.g. "24h", "7d", "30d", "90d", max "365d"). Defaults to "24h".

data.description: Data holds the query rows, totals, execution plan metadata, and freshness metadata.

msg.description: Msg carries an error message when Status is "error", empty otherwise.

status.description: Status is "ok" on success or "error" on failure.

dimensions.description: Dimensions maps each requested group_by key to its string value for this row.

values.description: Values maps each requested canonical metric ID to its numeric value for this row.

capacity.description: Capacity is the maximum allowed concurrent Datastore queries.

inFlight.description: InFlight is the number of Datastore queries currently executing.

rejected.description: Rejected is the cumulative count of queries rejected due to semaphore exhaustion.

utilizationPct.description: UtilizationPct is InFlight / Capacity expressed as a percentage (0–100).

activeScopes.description: ActiveScopes is the number of scopes with an active background refresh ticker.

activeStreams.description: ActiveStreams is the total number of currently connected SSE subscribers across all scopes.

code.description: A stable token a client can branch on, when the refusal names one.

detail.description: What was refused, for a person to read.

bearer.description: The caller's credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is either an access token minted by Hanzo IAM or an API key (pk-/sk-). X-Authorization, and HTTP Basic carrying the token as the password, are accepted spellings of the same header for clients that cannot set Authorization; a browser presents the session cookie instead. Every operation requires it unless it says `security: []`.
